seo.countryHowToH2: How to watch {countryName} TV on your device
seo.countryHowToIntro: No app or account is needed to watch {countryName} channels. This page works directly in your browser on any device - just tap a channel and press play.
seo.countryHowToAndroid: Open this page in Chrome, tap a {countryName} channel to start watching, then use the fullscreen button for the best view. For quick access next time, tap the Chrome menu and choose "Add to Home Screen" to create an app-like icon.
seo.countryHowToIOS: Open this page in Safari and tap any {countryName} channel to start streaming instantly. Tap the Share icon and select "Add to Home Screen" for one-tap access without downloading an app from the App Store.
seo.countryHowToDesktop: Any modern browser works - Chrome, Safari, Firefox or Edge. Open a {countryName} channel and use the fullscreen icon in the player for a distraction-free, TV-like viewing experience.
seo.countryHowToSmartTV: Open this page in your TV's built-in browser, or cast it from your phone or laptop using Chromecast or AirPlay to watch {countryName} channels on the big screen.

seo.countryFaqFreeQ: Is watching {countryName} TV on FreeTV Garden free?
seo.countryFaqFreeA: Yes. FreeTV Garden aggregates Free-to-Air (FTA) channels that are publicly available online. There is no subscription, account or app required to watch.
seo.countryFaqCountQ: How many {countryName} channels does FreeTV Garden have?
seo.countryFaqCountA: Currently around {count} live channels, spanning categories like {categories}.
seo.countryFaqCountNoneA: The channel count changes frequently as public streams go on and offline — open the tool above to see what's live right now.
seo.countryFaqCountUpdates: This list updates automatically from the public iptv-org directory.
seo.countryFaqBufferQ: Why do some {countryName} channels buffer or fail to load?
seo.countryFaqBufferA: You're connecting directly to the broadcaster's own server, so speed and reliability depend on their infrastructure, not ours. If one channel doesn't load, try another from the list.
seo.countryFaqPhoneQ: Can I watch {countryName} news channels live on my phone?
seo.countryFaqPhoneA: Yes — the player works on any phone browser with no app download. Just open this page, tap a news channel, and use fullscreen for the best view.
seo.countryFaqOfficialQ: Is this the official website of any {countryName} broadcaster?
seo.countryFaqOfficialA: No. FreeTV Garden is an independent directory linking to publicly available streams. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or operated by any broadcaster listed on this page.
